# Salesforce2Sql — Copilot Instructions

This project's contributor and AI-assistant guidance lives in `CLAUDE.md` files. Read them before making changes and follow them as if they were written here:

- [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md): project overview, structure, commands, coding style, security, and testing.
- [src/CLAUDE.md](../src/CLAUDE.md): main-process modules, the IPC handler pattern, and test mocking conventions.
- [app/CLAUDE.md](../app/CLAUDE.md): renderer processes, the preload IPC allowlists, and jsdom tests.

In short: follow the Airbnb style guide, run `npm run lint` and `npm test` before committing, and never commit OAuth secrets.
